method: Completed a disposable 'ZZ probe complete' task by clicking its checkbox from the LIST view (not the detail view), polling every ~250ms for the toast and recording its text/role/aria-live chain the first time it was seen, then noting the last-present and gone-by timestamps. Deleted the task afterward (Todoist: via More actions > Delete, after confirming aria-checked=true on its checkbox; meologue: via taskStore.remove after locating it with taskStore.listCompleted()).

todoist.note: Neither the toast element nor any ancestor up to <html> carried role or aria-live this round. This differs from the corpus's historical flow-5 record of role="alert" aria-live="polite", which round 3 could not re-confirm live either (toast had already gone by the time it checked). Two consecutive live rounds now find no role/aria-live on Todoist's toast chain -- recorded as observed, not asserted against the older corpus note.

meologue.note: role is null on the toast <ol> itself, but the wrapping <section class="toaster group">'s parent SECTION carries aria-live="polite" two levels up. Duration ~10.2s (goneByMs - firstSeenMs), matching the brief's expected ~10s.

verdict.wording: MATCH -- '1 task completedUndo' verbatim in both apps.
verdict.duration: MATCH -- Todoist ~10.3s (10646-368ms), meologue ~10.2s (10288-76ms); both consistent with the expected ~10s toast duration.
verdict.roleAndAriaLive: DIFFERS in mechanism, though neither exposes an ARIA role on the toast text element itself: Todoist's toast chain has no aria-live anywhere in the first 5 ancestors; meologue's toast chain has aria-live="polite" on the toaster's SECTION ancestor two levels up. This is a real, newly-observed structural difference this round (round 3 did not capture Todoist's chain live, only meologue's).
verdict.overall: MOSTLY MATCH -- text and timing match; the accessibility-tree exposure (aria-live) differs between the two toast implementations.
